# Copilot instructions

**Always read [`docs/DEVELOPER_GUIDE.md`](../docs/DEVELOPER_GUIDE.md) before suggesting or making changes**. It documents the architecture, Google Sheet data model, backend API, safe sheet migration, security model and conventions. Keep it updated (including its Changelog) when behaviour changes.

The project rules (commands, security, non-destructive sheet migrations, audit logging, service-worker cache bumps, testing, theme) are in [`CLAUDE.md`](../CLAUDE.md). Follow them exactly.
